semantics.label: Introduction
semantics.description: Optional text shown before the learner starts the image flash. May contain HTML.

fields.label: Image
fields.description: Image shown briefly after the learner starts the flash.

fields.label: Alternative text
fields.description: Describes the flash image for screen reader users.

fields.label: Display duration (ms)
fields.description: How long the image stays visible after start. Allowed range: 100–10000 milliseconds.

semantics.label: Question
semantics.description: Question shown after the image flash ends.

fields.label: Allow repeating the image flash
fields.description: When enabled, learners see a separate button to flash the image again while answering.

fields.label: Question type
fields.description: Automatic uses radio buttons for one correct answer and checkboxes for several.

fields.label: Give one point for the whole task
fields.description: When enabled, learners get either full score or zero (all-or-nothing).

fields.label: Maximum score
fields.description: Used when "Give one point for the whole task" is disabled. With single-point mode the effective max score is 1.

fields.label: No answer selected
fields.default: Please select an answer before checking.
